    returns="Geometry（原点在中心；端口 layer{i} 层中心、interface{i} 界面中点、dendrite{k}_base/_tip、void{k}、crack{k}_tip/_mouth、pinhole{k}、delamination{k}、particle{k}、flux{k}、whisker{k}_base/_tip、adsorbate{k}）",
    semantics=(
        "layers 同 layer_stack：[(名称, 厚度, 颜色[, 纹理])]；纹理另有 polycrystal（Voronoi 晶粒+晶界）/mosaic（SEI 式 2–3 色纳米畴）。",
        'stack="down" 自上而下叠层（界面水平），"right" 自左向右（Li | SEI | SSE）；length 为沿界面的长度，grain 为晶粒尺寸；层名写在叠层外侧，挤时自动错开加引线。',
        "features 每项 (类型, 界面序号 i, 沿界面位置 0–1[, 尺寸][, {选项}])，界面 i 位于第 i 与 i+1 层之间；尺寸为正伸入后一层、为负伸入前一层。",
        "类型：dendrite 分叉渐细枝晶（可穿过薄层继续生长，多晶层中沿晶界）、void 界面透镜状空洞（尺寸为宽度）、crack 张开型锯齿裂纹（多晶中沿晶界；选项 through=True 贯穿整层、width 口宽）、pinhole 贯穿针孔、delamination 界面分层（尺寸为长度）、"
        'particle 界面夹杂颗粒（尺寸为半径）、flux 穿过界面的箭头（选项 label="Li⁺"、color、dashed=True 画漏电子）、whisker 顶端生长纤维（积碳/纳米线：纤维从表面长出、催化颗粒被顶在顶端，尺寸为长度，选项 r 顶端颗粒半径、tip 颗粒色）、'
        "adsorbate 表面吸附原子单层（尺寸为覆盖段长度，选项 coverage=0–1 覆盖度 θ、r、fill）；选项 fill 改颜色。",
        '纹理与枝晶/空洞明暗在 style="rich" 的局部 SVG 中；晶粒、畴、枝晶、空洞、文字都是原生形状；"flat" 全原生。',
    ),
    example='sec = d.place(interface_section([("Li", 70, "#C3C9D2", "metal"), ("SEI", 16, "#B9A27C", "mosaic"), ("Li₆PS₅Cl", 150, "#E6DCC6", "polycrystal")],\n'
    '    length=220, stack="right", features=[("dendrite", 0, .35, 120), ("void", 0, .7, -40), ("flux", 0, .15, 36, {"label": "Li⁺"})]), at=(300, 220))\n'
    'd.callout("dend", "沿晶界枝晶", sec.port("dendrite0_tip"), at=(480, 120), font_size=14)',
    rank=6,
)
def interface_section(
    layers, *, length=260, stack="down", features=(), grain=26, font_size=13, label_fill="#1E191C", style="rich", seed=7
):
    _finite(length, grain, font_size)
    if stack not in ("down", "right"):
        raise ValueError('stack must be "down" or "right"')
    rich = _rich(style)
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    L = float(length)
    down = stack == "down"

    def P(u, v):
        return (u, v) if down else (v, u)

    def pd(pts, close=True):
        return _poly_d([P(u, v) for u, v in pts], close)

    def rect(u, v, du, dv, **kw):
        x, y = P(u, v)
        return _el("rect", x=x, y=y, width=du if down else dv, height=dv if down else du, **kw)

    specs, v = [], 0.0
    for item in layers:
        tex = item[3] if len(item) > 3 else None
        if tex not in _SECTION_TEXTURES:
            raise ValueError("layer texture must be grain/porous/metal/glass/polycrystal/mosaic/None")
        specs.append((item[0], v, float(item[1]), item[2], tex))
        v += float(item[1])
    T = v
    holder, defs = _start()
    holder.append(rect(0, 0, L, T, fill=specs[0][3], data_outline="1"))
    for _, v0, th, fill, _ in specs:
        holder.append(rect(0, v0, L, th, fill=fill))

    # native textures: grains / nanodomains as one compound path per tint, boundaries as one path
    gb = {}
    for i, (_, v0, th, fill, tex) in enumerate(specs):
        if tex not in ("polycrystal", "mosaic"):
            continue
        mosaic = tex == "mosaic"
        cell = max(3.0, min(grain * 0.28, th / 2.2)) if mosaic else grain
        cells, edges = _domains(rnd, 0, v0, L, th, cell)
        tints = (
            (fill, _mix(fill, "#FFFFFF", 0.42), _mix(fill, "#000000", 0.2))
            if mosaic
            else (_mix(fill, "#FFFFFF", 0.14), fill, _mix(fill, "#000000", 0.07))
        )
        groups = [[] for _ in tints]
        for poly in cells:
            groups[rnd.choices(range(3), (5, 3, 2) if mosaic else (1, 1, 1))[0]].append(pd(poly))
        for tint, ds in zip(tints, groups):
            if ds:
                holder.append(_el("path", d=" ".join(ds), fill=tint, stroke="none"))
        line = _mix(fill, "#000000", 0.3 if mosaic else 0.42)
        holder.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=" ".join(pd(e, False) for e in edges),
                fill="none",
                stroke=line,
                stroke_width=0.45 if mosaic else 0.9,
                stroke_opacity=0.7 if mosaic else None,
                stroke_linejoin="round",
            )
        )
        if not mosaic:
            gb[i] = (edges, cell)
    if rich:
        look = _look()
        inner = _el("g", transform=None if down else "matrix(0 1 1 0 0 0)")
        for i, (_, v0, th, fill, tex) in enumerate(specs):
            if tex in _TEXTURES and tex:
                _texture(inner, defs, tex, 0, v0, L, th, fill, i, rnd)
            elif tex:
                gid = f"is_shade{i}"
                defs.append(_linear(gid, [(0, "#FFFFFF", 0.3), (0.5, "#FFFFFF", 0.0), (1, "#000000", 0.1)]))
                inner.append(_el("rect", x=0, y=v0, width=L, height=th, fill=f"url(#{gid})"))
                if tex == "mosaic":
                    for _ in range(int(L * th / 40)):
                        inner.append(
                            _el(
                                "circle",
                                cx=rnd.uniform(1, L - 1),
                                cy=rnd.uniform(v0 + 1, v0 + th - 1),
                                r=rnd.uniform(0.5, 1.2),
                                fill=_mix(fill, "#000000", 0.45),
                                fill_opacity=0.5,
                            )
                        )
        look.append(inner)
        holder.append(look)
    if len(specs) > 1:
        holder.append(
            _el(
                "path",
                d=" ".join(pd([(0, v0), (L, v0)], False) for _, v0, *_ in specs[1:]),
                fill="none",
                stroke=_mix(specs[0][3], "#000000", 0.55),
                stroke_width=1.1,
            )
        )

    feats = [_feature(f, len(specs) - 1) for f in features]
    ports = {f"layer{i}": P(L / 2, v0 + th / 2) for i, (_, v0, th, _, _) in enumerate(specs)}
    ports.update({f"interface{i}": P(L / 2, specs[i + 1][1]) for i in range(len(specs) - 1)})
    counts, shine, boxes = {}, [], [Box(-0.6, -0.6, (L if down else T) + 1.2, (T if down else L) + 1.2)]
    for kind, k, at, size, opts in feats:
        n = counts[kind] = counts.get(kind, -1) + 1
        vi, u0 = specs[k + 1][1], at * L
        sign = -1 if size is not None and size < 0 else 1
        tgt = k + 1 if sign > 0 else k
        src = specs[k if sign > 0 else k + 1]
        tth = specs[tgt][2]
        if kind in ("dendrite", "crack"):
            depth = abs(size) if size else tth * (0.75 if kind == "dendrite" else 0.5)
            if kind == "crack" and opts.get("through"):
                depth = tth
            # grow layer by layer (a dendrite may pierce a thin SEI first); follow grain boundaries where present
            trunk, arms, left, j, cur = [(u0, vi)], [], depth, tgt, (u0, vi)
            while left > 1 and 0 <= j < len(specs):
                jv0, jth = specs[j][1], specs[j][2]
                far = jv0 + jth if sign > 0 else jv0
                step = min(left, abs(far - cur[1]))
                seg, adj = _gb_walk(rnd, gb[j][0], cur, sign, step, gb[j][1]) if j in gb else (None, None)
                if not seg:  # no grain boundary to follow: free jagged growth
                    n_st = max(2, int(step / 9))
                    seg = _walk(
                        rnd,
                        cur[0],
                        cur[1],
                        sign * math.pi / 2,
                        step,
                        n_st,
                        0.3 if kind == "dendrite" else (0.22 if opts.get("through") else 0.55),
                    )
                    gain = (seg[-1][1] - cur[1]) or 1  # stretch so the walk ends exactly `step` deep
                    seg = [(u, cur[1] + (v_ - cur[1]) * sign * step / gain) for u, v_ in seg]
                seg = [cur] + seg[1:]
                base = len(trunk) - 1
                arms += [
                    (base + i, a)
                    for i, a in _branches(rnd, seg, sign, depth, adj, gb[j][1] if adj else depth / 4, jv0, jv0 + jth)
                    if jth > depth * 0.2
                ]
                trunk += seg[1:]
                left -= abs(seg[-1][1] - cur[1])
                cur = seg[-1]
                if abs(cur[1] - far) > 2:
                    break
                j += sign
            if kind == "dendrite":
                color = opts.get("fill") or _mix(src[3], "#000000", 0.08)
                w0 = max(3.0, depth * 0.075)
                shapes = [_taper(trunk, w0, 1.0)]
                shapes += [_taper(arm, max(1.4, w0 * (1 - i / len(trunk)) * 0.6), 0.7) for i, arm in arms]
                shapes.append(
                    [(u0 - w0 * 1.6, vi)]
                    + [
                        (
                            u0 + w0 * 1.6 * math.cos(math.pi - math.pi * q / 10),
                            vi + sign * w0 * 1.1 * math.sin(math.pi * q / 10),
                        )
                        for q in range(11)
                    ]
                )
                d_all = " ".join(pd(s) for s in shapes)
                holder.append(
                    _el(
                        "path",
                        d=d_all,
                        fill=_mix(color, "#000000", 0.45),
                        stroke=_mix(color, "#000000", 0.45),
                        stroke_width=1.3,
                        stroke_linejoin="round",
                    )
                )
                holder.append(_el("path", d=d_all, fill=color, stroke="none"))
                shine.append(
                    _el(
                        "path",
                        d=pd([(u + w0 * 0.18, v_) for u, v_ in trunk[1:-1]], False),
                        fill="none",
                        stroke="#FFFFFF",
                        stroke_opacity=0.6,
                        stroke_width=max(0.8, w0 * 0.3),
                        stroke_linecap="round",
                        stroke_linejoin="round",
                    )
                )
                ports[f"dendrite{n}_base"], ports[f"dendrite{n}_tip"] = P(*trunk[0]), P(*trunk[-1])
            else:
                # opening-mode crack: wedge that is widest at the mouth, jagged walls, dark rim around the open gap
                mouth = float(opts.get("width") or max(2.6, depth * 0.07))
                through = bool(opts.get("through"))
                tip_w = mouth * 0.45 if through else 0.3
                shapes = [_taper(trunk, mouth, tip_w)] + (
                    [] if through else [_taper(arm, mouth * 0.4, 0.2) for _, arm in arms[:2] if len(arm) > 1]
                )
                rim = _mix(specs[tgt][3], "#000000", 0.6)
                gap = opts.get("fill") or ("#FBFCFD" if mouth >= 2.5 else _mix(specs[tgt][3], "#000000", 0.72))
                d_all = " ".join(pd(s) for s in shapes)
                holder.append(_el("path", d=d_all, fill=gap, stroke=rim, stroke_width=0.9, stroke_linejoin="round"))
                shine.append(
                    _el(
                        "path",
                        d=pd([(u - mouth * 0.2, v_) for u, v_ in trunk[:-1]], False),
                        fill="none",
                        stroke="#000000",
                        stroke_opacity=0.18,
                        stroke_width=max(0.8, mouth * 0.3),
                        stroke_linecap="round",
                    )
                )
                ports[f"crack{n}_tip"] = P(*trunk[-1])
                ports[f"crack{n}_mouth"] = P(*trunk[0])
        elif kind == "void":
            w = abs(size) if size else L * 0.14
            deep, shallow = w * 0.3, w * 0.06
            ph = rnd.uniform(0, 6.3)
            top = [
                (
                    u0 - w / 2 + w * j / 24,
                    vi + sign * deep * math.sin(math.pi * j / 24) ** 0.7 * (1 + 0.1 * math.sin(ph + j * 0.3)),
                )
                for j in range(25)
            ]
            bot = [(u0 + w / 2 - w * j / 24, vi - sign * shallow * math.sin(math.pi * j / 24)) for j in range(1, 24)]
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(top + bot),
                    fill=opts.get("fill") or "#FBFCFD",
                    stroke=_mix(src[3], "#000000", 0.5),
                    stroke_width=0.9,
                    stroke_linejoin="round",
                )
            )
            shine.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(top[3:-3], False),
                    fill="none",
                    stroke="#000000",
                    stroke_opacity=0.12,
                    stroke_width=max(1.5, deep * 0.25),
                    stroke_linecap="round",
                )
            )
            ports[f"void{n}"] = P(u0, vi + sign * deep * 0.45)
        elif kind == "pinhole":
            # through-thickness pinhole across layer `tgt`: hourglass channel, slightly wider at both faces
            far = specs[tgt][1] + (specs[tgt][2] if sign > 0 else 0)
            r = abs(size) if size else max(2.5, tth * 0.09)
            steps = 10
            left, right = [], []
            for j in range(steps + 1):
                t = j / steps
                vv = vi + (far - vi) * t
                wj = r * (1 - 0.45 * math.sin(math.pi * t)) * (1 + rnd.uniform(-0.12, 0.12))
                du = r * 0.5 * math.sin(t * 5 + at * 9)
                left.append((u0 + du - wj, vv))
                right.append((u0 + du + wj, vv))
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(left + right[::-1]),
                    fill=opts.get("fill") or "#FBFCFD",
                    stroke=_mix(specs[tgt][3], "#000000", 0.55),
                    stroke_width=0.9,
                    stroke_linejoin="round",
                )
            )
            shine.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(left, False),
                    fill="none",
                    stroke="#000000",
                    stroke_opacity=0.15,
                    stroke_width=max(1, r * 0.4),
                )
            )
            ports[f"pinhole{n}"] = P(u0, (vi + far) / 2)
        elif kind == "delamination":
            # interfacial debond: long flat gap along interface k with rough walls, slightly opened in the middle
            w = abs(size) if size else L * 0.3
            open_ = float(opts.get("width") or max(3.0, min(src[2], tth) * 0.22))
            top, bot = [], []
            for j in range(25):
                t = j / 24
                uu = u0 - w / 2 + w * t
                env = math.sin(math.pi * t) ** 0.5
                top.append((uu, vi - sign * open_ * 0.35 * env * (1 + rnd.uniform(-0.25, 0.25))))
                bot.append((uu, vi + sign * open_ * 0.65 * env * (1 + rnd.uniform(-0.25, 0.25))))
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(top + bot[::-1]),
                    fill=opts.get("fill") or "#FBFCFD",
                    stroke=_mix(src[3], "#000000", 0.5),
                    stroke_width=0.9,
                    stroke_linejoin="round",
                )
            )
            shine.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(top[2:-2], False),
                    fill="none",
                    stroke="#000000",
                    stroke_opacity=0.15,
                    stroke_width=max(1, open_ * 0.25),
                )
            )
            ports[f"delamination{n}"] = P(u0, vi)
        elif kind == "particle":
            r = abs(size) if size else min(s[2] for s in specs) * 0.3 + 3
            cv = vi + sign * r * 0.35
            blob = [
                (
                    u0 + r * (1 + 0.12 * math.sin(3 * a + 1)) * math.cos(a),
                    cv + r * (1 + 0.1 * math.cos(2 * a)) * math.sin(a),
                )
                for a in [2 * math.pi * j / 28 for j in range(28)]
            ]
            fill = opts.get("fill") or "#6E7F96"
            holder.append(_el("path", d=pd(blob), fill=fill, stroke=_mix(fill, "#000000", 0.4), stroke_width=0.9))
            if rich:
                defs.append(_spot(f"is_p{n}", fill))
                shine.append(_el("path", d=pd(blob), fill=f"url(#is_p{n})"))
            ports[f"particle{n}"] = P(u0, cv)
        elif kind == "whisker":
            # tip-growth fibre: filament grows from the surface into the next layer, the catalyst particle rides on its tip
            Lw = abs(size) if size else tth * 0.7
            mr = float(opts.get("r") or max(3.0, Lw * 0.09))
            cw = mr * 1.3
            a = sign * math.pi / 2 + rnd.uniform(-0.3, 0.3)
            pts, p = [(u0, vi)], (u0, vi)
            for _ in range(9):
                a += rnd.uniform(-0.32, 0.32)
                a = (
                    min(max(a, sign * math.pi / 2 - 0.7), sign * math.pi / 2 + 0.7)
                    if sign > 0
                    else max(min(a, sign * math.pi / 2 + 0.7), sign * math.pi / 2 - 0.7)
                )
                p = (p[0] + Lw / 9 * math.cos(a), p[1] + Lw / 9 * math.sin(a))
                pts.append(p)
            color = opts.get("fill") or "#2F2D2C"
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(_taper(pts, cw, cw * 0.92)),
                    fill=color,
                    stroke=_mix(color, "#000000", 0.5),
                    stroke_width=0.7,
                    stroke_linejoin="round",
                )
            )
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=pd(pts[1:-1], False),
                    fill="none",
                    stroke=_mix(color, "#FFFFFF", 0.45),
                    stroke_width=max(0.6, cw * 0.22),
                    stroke_dasharray=f"{fmt(cw * 0.9)} {fmt(cw * 0.6)}",
                )
            )
            hx, hy = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
            tx, ty = pts[-1]
            tip = [
                (
                    tx
                    + hx * mr * 0.55
                    + mr * (1 + 0.25 * math.cos(q)) * math.cos(q) * hx
                    - mr * 0.85 * math.sin(q) * hy,
                    ty
                    + hy * mr * 0.55
                    + mr * (1 + 0.25 * math.cos(q)) * math.cos(q) * hy
                    + mr * 0.85 * math.sin(q) * hx,
                )
                for q in [2 * math.pi * j / 18 for j in range(18)]
            ]
            mfill = opts.get("tip") or src[3]
            holder.append(_el("path", d=pd(tip), fill=mfill, stroke=_mix(mfill, "#000000", 0.45), stroke_width=1))
            if rich:
                defs.append(_spot(f"is_w{n}", mfill))
                shine.append(_el("path", d=pd(tip), fill=f"url(#is_w{n})"))
            ports[f"whisker{n}_base"], ports[f"whisker{n}_tip"] = P(u0, vi), P(tx + hx * mr * 1.2, ty + hy * mr * 1.2)
        elif kind == "adsorbate":
            # surface coverage θ: adsorbed atoms in a monolayer on the face of the previous (sign>0) layer
            span = abs(size) if size else L * 0.5
            cov = min(max(float(opts.get("coverage", 0.5)), 0.0), 1.0)
            ar = float(opts.get("r") or max(2.4, min(tth, src[2]) * 0.07))
            n_site = max(1, int(span / (ar * 2.15)))
            u_start = min(max(u0 - span / 2, ar), L - ar - n_site * ar * 2.15)
            sites = [u_start + ar * 1.075 + j * ar * 2.15 for j in range(n_site)]
            occ = sorted(rnd.sample(sites, round(cov * len(sites))))  # exactly θ of the sites occupied
            color = opts.get("fill") or "#E9C21C"
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=" ".join(_circ(*P(u, vi + sign * ar * 0.95), ar) for u in occ) or "M0 0",
                    fill=color,
                    stroke=_mix(color, "#000000", 0.45),
                    stroke_width=max(0.4, ar * 0.22),
                )
            )
            if occ:
                ports[f"adsorbate{n}"] = P(occ[len(occ) // 2], vi + sign * ar)
        else:  # flux arrow across the interface
            span = abs(size) if size else 36.0
            color = opts.get("color") or "#D9822B"
            a, b = (u0, vi - sign * span / 2), (u0, vi + sign * span / 2)
            (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = P(*a), P(u0, b[1] - sign * 7)
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=f"M{fmt(x1)} {fmt(y1)} L{fmt(x2)} {fmt(y2)}",
                    fill="none",
                    stroke=color,
                    stroke_width=2.2,
                    stroke_linecap="round",
                    stroke_dasharray="4 3" if opts.get("dashed") else None,
                )
            )
            hx, hy = P(*b)
            holder.append(_head(hx, hy, hx - x1, hy - y1, 8, color))
            if opts.get("label"):
                fs = font_size * 0.95
                lx, ly = (
                    (u0 + fs * 0.4, vi + fs * 0.36) if down else (a[1] + (0 if sign > 0 else -span), u0 - fs * 0.45)
                )
                t, bb = _text(
                    lx, ly, opts["label"], fs, fill=_mix(color, "#000000", 0.25), anchor="start", weight="bold"
                )
                holder.append(t)
                boxes.append(bb)
            ports[f"flux{n}"] = P(u0, vi)
    if rich and shine:
        look = _look()
        look.extend(shine)
        holder.append(look)
    holder.append(rect(0, 0, L, T, fill="none", stroke="#5E6773", stroke_width=1))

    # layer names outside the section, spread apart with leaders when crowded
    names = [(i, name, v0 + th / 2) for i, (name, v0, th, _, _) in enumerate(specs) if name]
    fs = font_size
    if down:
        need = [fs * 1.3] * len(names)
    else:
        need = [label(str(nm), font_size=fs, font_weight="bold").bounds.width + fs * 0.6 for _, nm, _ in names]
    pos = [m for _, _, m in names]
    for j in range(1, len(pos)):
        pos[j] = max(pos[j], pos[j - 1] + (need[j - 1] + need[j]) / 2)
    if pos:
        shift = sum(p - m for p, (_, _, m) in zip(pos, names)) / len(pos)
        pos = [p - shift for p in pos]
    moved = any(abs(p - m) > 1 for p, (_, _, m) in zip(pos, names))
    gap = fs * (1.6 if moved else 0.5)
    segs = []
    for (i, name, mid), p in zip(names, pos):
        if down:
            t, b = _text(L + gap, p + fs * 0.36, name, fs, fill=label_fill, anchor="start", weight="bold")
            if abs(p - mid) > 1:
                segs.append(f"M{fmt(L)} {fmt(mid)} L{fmt(L + gap - 3)} {fmt(p)}")
        else:
            t, b = _text(p, -gap - fs * 0.1, name, fs, fill=label_fill, weight="bold")
            if abs(p - mid) > 1:
                segs.append(f"M{fmt(mid)} 0 L{fmt(p)} {fmt(-gap + 2)}")
        holder.append(t)
        boxes.append(b)
    if segs:
        holder.append(_el("path", d=" ".join(segs), fill="none", stroke=_INK, stroke_width=0.8))
    return _finish(holder, defs, _union(boxes), **ports)


@_drawing_api(
    "parts",
    purpose="锂离子电池截面示意：两侧金属集流体、颗粒堆积正极、多孔隔膜、层状石墨负极，电解液中 Li⁺ 迁移箭头与外电路电子流。",
    returns="Geometry（原点在中心；端口 cathode/separator/anode 为各区中心，plus/minus 为正负极外电路接点）",
    semantics=(
        "width/height 为电池本体尺寸（外电路与底部标签在其外）；cathode/anode/electrolyte/ion 为各部分颜色。",
        'direction="discharge" 时 Li⁺ 由负极经隔膜迁向正极、电子经外电路流向正极（外接“负载”）；"charge" 相反（外接“电源”）。',
        'labels=True 在底部写 集流体/正极/隔膜/负极 等文字标签；style="rich" 加颗粒立体感与金属光泽（局部 SVG）。',
    ),
    example='d.place(battery_cell(440, 220, direction="discharge"), at=(480, 280), key="cell")',
    rank=7,
)
def battery_cell(
    width=420,
    height=220,
    *,
    cathode="#C0504D",
    anode="#4A6FA5",
    electrolyte="#EAF3FA",
    ion="#E0A458",
    labels=True,
    direction="discharge",
    style="rich",
    font_size=13,
    seed=5,
):
    _finite(width, height)
    if direction not in ("discharge", "charge"):
        raise ValueError('direction must be "discharge" or "charge"')
    rich = _rich(style)
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    W, H = float(width), float(height)
    holder, defs = _start()
    cc = max(7.0, W * 0.022)  # current collector thickness
    gap = W * 0.085  # electrolyte gap on each side of the separator
    sep = max(8.0, W * 0.028)
    elec = (W - 2 * cc - 2 * gap - sep) / 2  # electrode width
    xc0, xc1 = cc, cc + elec  # cathode
    xs0 = xc1 + gap  # separator
    xa0 = xs0 + sep + gap  # anode
    xa1 = xa0 + elec
    pad = H * 0.06
    holder.append(
        _el("rect", x=0, y=0, width=W, height=H, fill=electrolyte, stroke="#7F8A96", stroke_width=1.2, data_outline="1")
    )
    al, cu = "#AEB5BE", "#C98B5A"
    holder.append(
        _el("rect", x=0, y=0, width=cc, height=H, fill=al, stroke=_mix(al, "#000000", 0.35), stroke_width=0.8)
    )
    holder.append(
        _el("rect", x=W - cc, y=0, width=cc, height=H, fill=cu, stroke=_mix(cu, "#000000", 0.35), stroke_width=0.8)
    )

    # cathode: packed spherical particles (separate circles)
    r = min(elec / 7.5, H / 13)
    edge_c = _mix(cathode, "#000000", 0.35)
    centers = []
    rows = int((H - 2 * pad) / (r * 1.75))
    for j in range(rows):
        cy = pad + r + j * (H - 2 * pad - 2 * r) / max(1, rows - 1)
        off = r * 0.9 if j % 2 else 0
        cx = xc0 + r + off + 1
        while cx + r <= xc1 + r * 0.3:
            rr = r * rnd.uniform(0.82, 1.0)
            centers.append((cx + rnd.uniform(-1, 1), cy + rnd.uniform(-1, 1), rr))
            cx += r * 1.85
    for cx, cy, rr in centers:
        holder.append(_el("circle", cx=cx, cy=cy, r=rr, fill=cathode, stroke=edge_c, stroke_width=0.8))

    sep_fill = "#F7F7F5"
    holder.append(_el("rect", x=xs0, y=0, width=sep, height=H, fill=sep_fill, stroke="#9AA3AE", stroke_width=0.8))
    k = 0
    yy = 5.0
    while yy < H - 4:
        px = xs0 + sep * (0.3 if k % 2 else 0.68)
        holder.append(_el("ellipse", cx=px, cy=yy, rx=sep * 0.16, ry=2.2, fill="#C9D1DA"))
        yy += 7.5
        k += 1

    edge_a = _mix(anode, "#000000", 0.35)
    fh = max(3.5, H / 34)
    fgap = fh * 0.55
    flakes = []
    y = pad
    j = 0
    while y + fh <= H - pad:
        x = xa0 + (elec * 0.08 if j % 2 else 0)
        while x < xa1 - 6:
            fw = min(elec * rnd.uniform(0.32, 0.48), xa1 - x)
            if fw > 6:
                flakes.append((x, y, fw - 2))
            x += fw + 2
        y += fh + fgap
        j += 1
    for x, y, fw in flakes:
        holder.append(
            _el("rect", x=x, y=y, width=fw, height=fh, rx=fh / 2, fill=anode, stroke=edge_a, stroke_width=0.6)
        )

    left_to_right = direction == "charge"
    ion_r = max(5.0, min(gap * 0.2, H * 0.035))
    ion_edge = _mix(ion, "#000000", 0.3)
    ions = []
    for frac in (0.18, 0.42, 0.66, 0.86):
        ions.append((xc1 + gap * 0.5 + rnd.uniform(-2, 2), H * frac))
        ions.append((xa0 - gap * 0.5 + rnd.uniform(-2, 2), H * (frac + 0.1 if frac < 0.8 else 0.08)))
    arrow_c = _mix(ion, "#000000", 0.35)
    segs = []
    for fy in (0.3, 0.55, 0.78):
        ay = H * fy
        a, b = xc1 + gap * 0.2, xa0 - gap * 0.2
        if left_to_right:
            segs.append(f"M{fmt(a)} {fmt(ay)} H{fmt(b - 8)}")
            heads = [(b, ay, 1)]
        else:
            segs.append(f"M{fmt(b)} {fmt(ay)} H{fmt(a + 8)}")
            heads = [(a, ay, -1)]
        for hx, hy, dx in heads:
            holder.append(_head(hx, hy, dx, 0, 9, arrow_c))
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "path",
            d=" ".join(segs),
            fill="none",
            stroke=arrow_c,
            stroke_width=2,
            stroke_linecap="round",
            stroke_dasharray="6 3",
        )
    )
    for cx, cy in ions:
        holder.append(_el("circle", cx=cx, cy=cy, r=ion_r, fill=ion, stroke=ion_edge, stroke_width=0.8))

    if rich:
        look = _look()
        defs.append(_spot("bc_p", cathode))
        for cx, cy, rr in centers:
            look.append(_el("circle", cx=cx, cy=cy, r=rr - 0.4, fill="url(#bc_p)"))
        defs.append(_linear("bc_fl", [(0, "#FFFFFF", 0.5), (0.45, "#FFFFFF", 0.05), (1, "#000000", 0.25)]))
        for x, y, fw in flakes:
            look.append(_el("rect", x=x, y=y, width=fw, height=fh, rx=fh / 2, fill="url(#bc_fl)"))
        defs.append(
            _linear(
                "bc_m",
                [(0, "#000000", 0.2), (0.35, "#FFFFFF", 0.55), (0.65, "#FFFFFF", 0.1), (1, "#000000", 0.25)],
                x2=1,
                y2=0,
            )
        )
        look.append(_el("rect", x=0, y=0, width=cc, height=H, fill="url(#bc_m)"))
        look.append(_el("rect", x=W - cc, y=0, width=cc, height=H, fill="url(#bc_m)"))
        defs.append(_spot("bc_i", ion))
        for cx, cy in ions:
            look.append(_el("circle", cx=cx, cy=cy, r=ion_r - 0.3, fill="url(#bc_i)"))
        defs.append(_linear("bc_el", [(0, "#FFFFFF", 0.35), (1, "#FFFFFF", 0.0)]))
        look.append(_el("rect", x=cc, y=0, width=W - 2 * cc, height=H * 0.25, fill="url(#bc_el)"))
        holder.append(look)
    pfs = max(7.0, ion_r * 1.5)
    for cx, cy in ions:
        t, _ = _text(cx, cy + pfs * 0.36, "+", pfs, fill="#FFFFFF" if _dark(ion) else _INK, weight="bold")
        holder.append(t)
    boxes = [Box(-0.6, -0.6, W + 1.2, H + 1.2)]

    fs = font_size
    top = -max(34.0, H * 0.2)
    wire = "#4B5563"
    px, nx = cc / 2, W - cc / 2
    lw, lh = max(54.0, fs * 4), fs * 1.9
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "path",
            d=f"M{fmt(px)} 0 V{fmt(top)} H{fmt(W / 2 - lw / 2)} M{fmt(W / 2 + lw / 2)} {fmt(top)} H{fmt(nx)} V0",
            fill="none",
            stroke=wire,
            stroke_width=1.6,
            stroke_linejoin="round",
        )
    )
    holder.append(
        _el(
            "rect",
            x=W / 2 - lw / 2,
            y=top - lh / 2,
            width=lw,
            height=lh,
            rx=4,
            fill="#FFFFFF",
            stroke=wire,
            stroke_width=1.4,
        )
    )
    t, _ = _text(W / 2, top + fs * 0.36, "电源" if left_to_right else "负载", fs, weight="bold")
    holder.append(t)
    ex = W * 0.25 if not left_to_right else W * 0.75
    edir = -1 if not left_to_right else 1
    e_x = W * 0.78 if not left_to_right else W * 0.22
    holder.append(_head(e_x + edir * 7, top, edir, 0, 9, "#2E7BC4"))
    t, b = _text(e_x, top - 7, "e⁻", fs, fill="#2E7BC4", weight="bold")
    holder.append(t)
    boxes.append(b)
    del ex
    for x, sym in ((px, "+"), (nx, "−")):
        t, b = _text(x, top - 7, sym, fs * 1.15, weight="bold", fill=_INK)
        holder.append(t)
        boxes.append(b)
    boxes.append(Box(0, top - lh / 2, W, -top + lh / 2))
    mode = "充电" if left_to_right else "放电"
    t, b = _text(W / 2, top - lh / 2 - 6, mode, fs, fill="#5B6573")
    holder.append(t)
    boxes.append(b)

    if labels:
        ly = H + fs * 1.45
        for x, txt in (
            (cc / 2, "集流体"),
            ((xc0 + xc1) / 2, "正极"),
            (xs0 + sep / 2, "隔膜"),
            ((xa0 + xa1) / 2, "负极"),
            (W - cc / 2, "集流体"),
        ):
            t, b = _text(x, ly, txt, fs, fill=_INK)
            holder.append(t)
            boxes.append(b)
        sub = fs * 0.85
        for x, txt in (
            (cc / 2, "(Al)"),
            (W - cc / 2, "(Cu)"),
            ((xc0 + xc1) / 2, "(LiCoO₂)"),
            ((xa0 + xa1) / 2, "(石墨)"),
        ):
            t, b = _text(x, ly + sub * 1.3, txt, sub, fill="#5B6573")
            holder.append(t)
            boxes.append(b)
        gy = ly + sub * 1.3 + fs * 1.5
        gx = W / 2 - fs * 3.2
        holder.append(_el("circle", cx=gx, cy=gy - fs * 0.35, r=ion_r, fill=ion, stroke=ion_edge, stroke_width=0.8))
        t, _ = _text(gx, gy - fs * 0.35 + pfs * 0.36, "+", pfs, fill="#FFFFFF" if _dark(ion) else _INK, weight="bold")
        holder.append(t)
        t, b = _text(gx + ion_r + 5, gy, "Li⁺（电解液中迁移）", sub, fill="#5B6573", anchor="start")
        holder.append(t)
        boxes.append(b)
        boxes.append(Box(gx - ion_r, gy - fs * 0.35 - ion_r, 2 * ion_r, 2 * ion_r))
    ports = dict(
        cathode=((xc0 + xc1) / 2, H / 2),
        separator=(xs0 + sep / 2, H / 2),
        anode=((xa0 + xa1) / 2, H / 2),
        plus=(px, top),
        minus=(nx, top),
    )
    return _finish(holder, defs, _union(boxes), **ports)


_SMALL = {"H": 0.62, "F": 0.8, "Cl": 0.95, "Li": 0.85}
CPK = {
    "H": "#F2F2F2",
    "C": "#404040",
    "N": "#3A5BD9",
    "O": "#E24C3B",
    "S": "#E8C536",
    "P": "#F08A24",
    "Cl": "#3FA34D",
    "F": "#8FD16A",
    "R": "#9AA1AB",
}
_CHARGES = "+-−⁺⁻"


def _preset(spec):
    """(symbol, x, y, z) atoms and (i, j, order) bonds; z > 0 is toward the viewer (drawn later, slightly larger)."""
    s3, L = 1 / math.sqrt(3), 40
    tet = [(s3, s3, s3), (-s3, -s3, s3), (-s3, s3, -s3), (s3, -s3, -s3)]

    def view(v, ry=0.3, rx=0.2):  # tilted view so no two tetrahedral atoms overlap
        x, y, z = v
        x, z = x * math.cos(ry) + z * math.sin(ry), -x * math.sin(ry) + z * math.cos(ry)
        return x * L, y * math.cos(rx) * L - z * math.sin(rx) * L, y * math.sin(rx) + z * math.cos(rx)

    if spec == "CO2":
        return [("O", -L, 0, 0), ("C", 0, 0, 0), ("O", L, 0, 0)], [(0, 1, 2), (1, 2, 2)]
    if spec == "H2O":  # H–O–H 104.5°
        a = math.radians(104.5 / 2)
        return [
            ("O", 0, 0, 0),
            ("H", -L * 0.85 * math.sin(a), L * 0.85 * math.cos(a), 0),
            ("H", L * 0.85 * math.sin(a), L * 0.85 * math.cos(a), 0),
        ], [(0, 1, 1), (0, 2, 1)]
    if spec == "CH4":
        return [("C", 0, 0, 0)] + [("H",) + view(v) for v in tet], [(0, k, 1) for k in range(1, 5)]
    if spec == "NH3":  # trigonal pyramid, lone pair up (H–N–H 107°)
        th = math.radians(112)
        hs = [
            (math.sin(th) * math.cos(a), -math.cos(th), math.sin(th) * math.sin(a))
            for a in map(math.radians, (20, 140, 260))
        ]
        return [("N", 0, -L * 0.15, 0)] + [("H",) + view(v, 0, 0.35) for v in hs], [(0, k, 1) for k in range(1, 4)]
    if spec in ("N2", "O2", "H2"):
        sym = spec[0]
        return [(sym, -L * 0.6, 0, 0), (sym, L * 0.6, 0, 0)], [(0, 1, {"N": 3, "O": 2, "H": 1}[sym])]
    if spec == "carbamate":  # R–NH–COO⁻ (planar, 120°)

        def go(p, deg):
            return p[0] + L * math.cos(math.radians(deg)), p[1] - L * math.sin(math.radians(deg))

        n = go((0, 0), 210)
        atoms = [
            ("C", 0, 0),
            ("O", *go((0, 0), 90)),
            ("O−", *go((0, 0), -30)),
            ("N", *n),
            ("R", *go(n, 150)),
            ("H", *go(n, 270)),
        ]
        return [a + (0,) for a in atoms], [(0, 1, 2), (0, 2, 1), (0, 3, 1), (3, 4, 1), (3, 5, 1)]
    if spec == "benzene":
        ring = [(math.cos(math.radians(90 + 60 * k)), -math.sin(math.radians(90 + 60 * k))) for k in range(6)]
        atoms = [("C", x * L * 1.1, y * L * 1.1, 0) for x, y in ring] + [
            ("H", x * L * 1.9, y * L * 1.9, 0) for x, y in ring
        ]
        return atoms, [(k, (k + 1) % 6, 2 if k % 2 == 0 else 1) for k in range(6)] + [(k, k + 6, 1) for k in range(6)]
    raise ValueError(f"unknown molecule preset {spec!r}; presets: {', '.join(MOLECULES)}")


MOLECULES = ("CO2", "H2O", "CH4", "NH3", "N2", "O2", "H2", "carbamate", "benzene")


@_drawing_api(
    "parts",
    purpose="球棍分子模型：原子小球 + 单/双/三键棍，教材风格立体高光；内置常见小分子（CO2/H2O/CH4/NH3/N2/O2/H2/carbamate/benzene）正确几何与 CPK 配色。",
    returns="Geometry（原点在中心；端口 atom_i 为第 i 个原子中心）",
    semantics=(
        '预设：molecule("CO2") 直线 O=C=O、"H2O" 104.5° 弯曲、"CH4" 四面体投影、"NH3" 三角锥、"N2" 叁键、"O2"/"H2"、'
        '"carbamate" 氨基甲酸根 R–NH–COO⁻（平面 120°，O⁻ 带电荷）、"benzene" 苯环（交替双键）；CPK 配色（C 深灰、O 红、N 蓝、H 白）。',
        "自定义：atoms 为 [(元素符号, x, y, 颜色[, z])]（局部坐标 px，乘 scale；z>0 朝向观众，后画并略大）；bonds 为 [(i, j, 键级)]，键级 1/2/3 画成平行棍。",
        '符号末尾带 + / − 时（如 "O−"）球心写元素、右上角写电荷；原子半径按元素自动取（H 较小）；labels=False 不写元素符号（小尺寸客体分子用）；rotate 为预设分子的旋转角（度）。',
        'style="rich" 加球面高光（局部 SVG），"flat" 纯色原生形状。',
    ),
    example='co2 = d.place(molecule("CO2", scale=.8), at=(300, 200), key="co2")\n'
    'd.place(molecule([("O", 0, 0, "#E24C3B"), ("H", -34, 24, "#F2F2F2"), ("H", 34, 24, "#F2F2F2")], [(0, 1, 1), (0, 2, 1)]), at=(420, 200))',
    rank=8,
)
def molecule(
    atoms,
    bonds=None,
    *,
    scale=1.0,
    style="rich",
    radius=14,
    bond_color="#9AA1AB",
    font_size=None,
    labels=True,
    rotate=0,
):
    if isinstance(atoms, str):
        raw, bonds = _preset(atoms)
        c, s_ = math.cos(math.radians(rotate)), math.sin(math.radians(rotate))
        raw = [(sym, x * c - y * s_, x * s_ + y * c, z) for sym, x, y, z in raw]
        atoms = [(sym, x, y, CPK[sym.rstrip(_CHARGES)], z) for sym, x, y, z in raw]
    if bonds is None:
        raise TypeError('molecule(atoms, bonds): pass bonds, or a preset name such as molecule("CO2")')
    depth = [float(a[4]) if len(a) > 4 else 0.0 for a in atoms]
    atoms = [tuple(a[:4]) for a in atoms]
    _finite(scale, radius)
    rich = _rich(style)
    holder, defs = _start()
    pts = [(float(x) * scale, float(y) * scale) for _, x, y, _ in atoms]
    radii = [
        radius * scale * _SMALL.get(sym.rstrip(_CHARGES), 1.0) * (1 + 0.1 * z) for (sym, *_), z in zip(atoms, depth)
    ]
    stack = sorted(range(len(atoms)), key=lambda k: depth[k])  # back to front
    sw = max(2.0, 4.2 * scale)
    spacing = sw * 1.35
    edge_b = _mix(bond_color, "#000000", 0.3)
    first = True
    for i, j, order in bonds:
        (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = pts[i], pts[j]
        L = math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1) or 1
        nx, ny = -(y2 - y1) / L, (x2 - x1) / L
        order = max(1, min(3, int(order)))
        for k in range(order):
            o = (k - (order - 1) / 2) * spacing
            d = f"M{fmt(x1 + nx * o)} {fmt(y1 + ny * o)} L{fmt(x2 + nx * o)} {fmt(y2 + ny * o)}"
            holder.append(
                _el(
                    "path",
                    d=d,
                    fill="none",
                    stroke=edge_b,
                    stroke_width=sw + 1.2,
                    stroke_linecap="round",
                    data_outline="1" if first else None,
                )
            )
            holder.append(_el("path", d=d, fill="none", stroke=bond_color, stroke_width=sw, stroke_linecap="round"))
            first = False
    for (sym, _, _, color), (x, y), r in ((atoms[k], pts[k], radii[k]) for k in stack):
        holder.append(
            _el(
                "circle",
                cx=x,
                cy=y,
                r=r,
                fill=color,
                stroke=_mix(color, "#000000", 0.35),
                stroke_width=0.9,
                data_outline="1" if first else None,
            )
        )
        first = False
    if rich:
        look = _look()
        defs.append(_linear("mol_st", [(0, "#FFFFFF", 0.55), (1, "#FFFFFF", 0.0)]))
        for i, j, order in bonds:
            (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = pts[i], pts[j]
            L = math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1) or 1
            nx, ny = -(y2 - y1) / L, (x2 - x1) / L
            order = max(1, min(3, int(order)))
            for k in range(order):
                o = (k - (order - 1) / 2) * spacing - sw * 0.22
                ux, uy = (x2 - x1) / L, (y2 - y1) / L
                a, b = radii[i] * 0.95, L - radii[j] * 0.95
                if b - a < 2:
                    continue
                look.append(
                    _el(
                        "path",
                        d=f"M{fmt(x1 + ux * a + nx * o)} {fmt(y1 + uy * a + ny * o)} "
                        f"L{fmt(x1 + ux * b + nx * o)} {fmt(y1 + uy * b + ny * o)}",
                        fill="none",
                        stroke="#FFFFFF",
                        stroke_opacity=0.5,
                        stroke_width=max(0.8, sw * 0.28),
                        stroke_linecap="round",
                    )
                )
        seen = {}
        for (sym, _, _, color), (x, y), r in ((atoms[k], pts[k], radii[k]) for k in stack):
            gid = seen.get(color)
            if gid is None:
                gid = seen[color] = f"mol_s{len(seen)}"
                defs.append(_spot(gid, color))
            look.append(_el("circle", cx=x, cy=y, r=r - 0.45, fill=f"url(#{gid})"))
        holder.append(look)
    boxes = []
    for (sym, _, _, color), (x, y), r in ((atoms[k], pts[k], radii[k]) for k in stack):
        boxes.append(Box(x - r - 0.5, y - r - 0.5, 2 * r + 1, 2 * r + 1))
        el, charge = sym.rstrip(_CHARGES), sym[len(sym.rstrip(_CHARGES)) :]
        if el and labels:
            fs = font_size or r * (0.95 if len(el) == 1 else 0.78)
            t, _ = _text(x, y + fs * 0.36, el, fs, fill="#FFFFFF" if _dark(color) else _INK, weight="bold")
            holder.append(t)
        if charge and labels:
            cfs = max(7, r * 0.8)
            t, b = _text(x + r * 0.8, y - r * 0.55, charge.replace("-", "−"), cfs, anchor="start", weight="bold")
            holder.append(t)
            boxes.append(b)
    ports = {f"atom_{i}": p for i, p in enumerate(pts)}
    return _finish(holder, defs, _union(boxes), **ports)

# 评分模型详细说明

本文档仅在需要深度解释评分逻辑时读取（如用户问"为什么分数高但星级低"、"分数怎么算的"等）。

---

## 模型概述

高德开店选址评估模型基于**行业内优质门店所在地块特征**构建算法，对目标区域进行五维综合评分。

> **使用建议**：评估数据仅供参考，建议用宏观数据把握方向，结合实地考察和物业条件综合判断。

---

## 分数逻辑

| 指标 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **综合总分** | 基于行业优质点位模型综合计算，**不是**各维度分数的加和或平均 |
| **客群聚集分** | 该区域人口维度综合评价，分数越高越接近行业优质水平 |
| **潜客匹配分** | 该区域行业潜客综合评价，分数越高越接近行业优质水平 |
| **同行竞争分** | 该区域竞争综合评价，分数越高越接近行业优质水平 |
| **交通便利分** | 该区域交通条件综合评价，分数越高越接近行业优质水平 |
| **商业成熟分** | 该区域商业配套综合评价，分数越高越接近行业优质水平 |

**雷达图取值说明**：各维度得分取自当前评估区域内行业 100m×100m 地块得分的**平均值**。区域范围较大时，平均值可能偏低，但不影响局部优质点位的识别。

---

## 分数与星级的区别（核心概念）

**「分数」和「星级」是两套完全不同的评价体系，禁止混用或互相推断。**

| 评价体系 | 含义 | 衡量标准 |
|---------|------|---------|
| **分数（score）** | 与行业优质点位模型的**接近程度** | 越高越接近优质水平，≠数量，≠排名 |
| **星级（starLevel）** | 该指标数量在**城市内所有商圈中的相对排名** | 越高表示数量排名越靠前，≠与优质模型接近程度 |
| **综合总分** | 行业优质点位模型综合计算结果 | **不是**各维度分数简单加和 |

### 禁止的错误推理

- ❌ 不要将星级视为分数的映射（星级高 ≠ 分数高）
- ❌ 不要将分数视为数量或排名（分数高 ≠ 该维度数量多）
- ❌ 不要根据维度星级推断维度分数
- ❌ 不要将总分视为维度分数的简单加总
- ✅ 若分数和星级不一致，解释为「评价口径不同」，属正常现象

### 示例说明

**示例1：同行竞争分数8.88（高），但星级0.5星（低）**

- **分数8.88高**：表示该区域竞争环境与行业优质点位模型高度接近。优质奶茶点位不需要周边一家同行都没有，适度竞争反而说明消费需求存在。
- **星级0.5星低**：表示周边同业门店数量在城市内排名靠后（数量少）。
- **解读**：周边同类店少（数量少→星级低），但竞争环境恰好符合行业优质模型（结构合理→分数高）。两者不矛盾。

**示例2：交通便利星级高，但分数中等**

- **星级高**：该区域地铁/公交站数量在城市中排名靠前。
- **分数中等**：该区域交通特征（如人流方向、时段分布）与行业优质点位的交通模型匹配度中等。
- **解读**：有很多交通设施不等于交通结构对该业态最优。

---

## 指标解读标准

| 指标 | 解读标准 |
|------|---------|
| **score（综合评分）** | >8分优质选址，5-8分一般，<5分不推荐 |
| **starLevel（星级）** | 1-5星，3星为中等；4-5星优秀；1-2星较差 |
| **abovePercent（超越百分比）** | >70%为显著优势；30-70%为中等；<30%为竞争力不足 |

---

## 特殊指标定义

| 指标 | 定义 |
|------|------|
| **潜客** | 区域在高德地图上当月内搜索或导航过选址行业线下门店的群体（UV） |
| **搜索群体** | 当月在高德地图搜索过选址行业线下门店的UV，反映"有多少人在找这类店" |
| **导航群体** | 当月在高德地图导航去过选址行业线下门店的UV，反映"有多少人已经行动去了" |
| **潜客总数** | 搜索+导航去重后的总UV |
| **点位热力值** | 基于该点位在高德地图的搜索、导航、到达人数综合计算的指数 |
| **存续时长** | 基于该点位在高德地图上线时间推算已存续时长 |

---

## 统一解读原则

Agent 在解读评估结果时，应**围绕五维综合评估逻辑**，而不是孤立复述单一指标：

1. 先说明这是基于**五个维度综合评估**（客群聚集、潜客匹配、同行竞争、交通便利、商业成熟）
2. 概括最突出的**优势维度**（高分/高abovePercent）
3. 指出需关注的**短板或风险维度**（低分/低abovePercent）
4. 结合用户行业，给出简要经营建议
5. **不要绝对判断**选址好坏，数据仅供参考

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
deploy_toolkit.py - Unified deploy-to-ECS toolkit.

Subcommands:
    check       Environment pre-check (aliyun CLI version + appmanager-cli version + credentials)
    price       Pre-deploy price query (calls `appmanager price`, prints a cost summary)
    deploy      Group-conflict auto-resolution + deployment execution
    verify      Post-deploy log verification (Cloud Assistant first, fallback to deployCommandOutput)

Usage:
    python3 deploy_toolkit.py check
    python3 deploy_toolkit.py price   [--config PATH]
    python3 deploy_toolkit.py deploy  [--type T --name N --group G --region R]
    python3 deploy_toolkit.py verify  [--type T --name N --group G --region R] [--wait S]

Exit codes:
    check:      0 = pass, 1 = issues found
    price:      0 = price query succeeded, 1 = failed
    deploy:     0 = deploy submitted, 1 = failed
    verify:     0 = running, 1 = failed, 2 = inconclusive

Dependencies:
    PyYAML==6.0.2  (declared in scripts/requirements.txt; install with
                    `pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt`,
                    or rely on the system python3-yaml package.)
"""

import argparse
import base64
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time


# ============================================================
# Shared utilities
# ============================================================

def run_cmd(cmd, capture=True, stream=False, env_override=None, timeout=None):
    """Run a shell command, return (exit_code, stdout, stderr)."""
    env = env_override or os.environ.copy()
    if stream:
        tmp = os.path.join("/tmp", f"deploy_toolkit_{os.getpid()}.log")
        with open(tmp, "w") as f:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, env=env)
            output_lines = []
            for line in proc.stdout:
                sys.stdout.write(line)
                sys.stdout.flush()
                output_lines.append(line)
            proc.wait()
        stdout = "".join(output_lines)
        return proc.returncode, stdout, ""
    else:
        try:
            proc = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=capture, text=True, env=env, timeout=timeout)
            return proc.returncode, proc.stdout, proc.stderr
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            return 1, "", "Command timed out"
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return 127, "", f"Command not found: {cmd[0]}"


def auto_read_config(config_path=".appmanager/config.yaml"):
    """Read metadata from .appmanager/config.yaml, return dict with type/name/groupName/regionId."""
    result = {"type": "", "name": "", "groupName": "", "regionId": ""}
    if not os.path.isfile(config_path):
        return result
    try:
        import yaml
        with open(config_path) as f:
            config = yaml.safe_load(f)
        meta = config.get("metadata", {})
        result["type"] = meta.get("type", "")
        result["name"] = meta.get("name", "")
        result["groupName"] = meta.get("groupName", "")
        result["regionId"] = meta.get("regionId", "")
    except Exception:
        pass
    return result


def _validate_param(value, name, pattern, max_len):
    """Validate a deployment param against an allow-list regex and length limit.

    Although subprocess list-passing already prevents shell injection, we still
    enforce strict format checks for defense-in-depth and to surface bad config
    early (e.g. a typo in regionId would otherwise reach the API).
    """
    if not value:
        return
    if len(value) > max_len:
        print(f"❌ Invalid --{name}: length {len(value)} > {max_len}")
        sys.exit(1)
    if not re.fullmatch(pattern, value):
        print(f"❌ Invalid --{name} format: '{value}' (allowed pattern: {pattern})")
        sys.exit(1)


def fill_params(args, config_path=".appmanager/config.yaml"):
    """Fill missing --type/--name/--group/--region from config.yaml."""
    needs_fill = (not args.type or not args.name or not args.group or not args.region)
    if needs_fill:
        print(f"ℹ️  Auto-reading params from {config_path} ...")
        cfg = auto_read_config(config_path)
        if not args.type:
            args.type = cfg["type"]
        if not args.name:
            args.name = cfg["name"]
        if not args.group:
            args.group = cfg["groupName"]
        if not args.region:
            args.region = cfg["regionId"]
    if not args.type or not args.name or not args.group or not args.region:
        print("❌ Missing required params. Provide --type/--name/--group/--region or run from a dir with .appmanager/config.yaml")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Format/length validation (defense-in-depth even though we use subprocess list mode)
    _validate_param(args.type,   "type",   r"agent|app",                   8)
    _validate_param(args.name,   "name",   r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}", 64)
    _validate_param(args.group,  "group",  r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}", 64)
    _validate_param(args.region, "region", r"[a-z]{2,8}-[a-z]+(-\d+)?",    32)
    return args


def version_gte(ver, required):
    """Check if version string ver >= required (semver-like)."""
    def parse(v):
        return [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'\d+', v)]
    return parse(ver) >= parse(required)


# ============================================================
# Subcommand: check
# ============================================================

def _detect_aliyun_paths():
    """Return list of all `aliyun` binaries on PATH (in PATH order).

    Used to surface multi-binary conflicts (e.g. brew /opt/homebrew/bin/aliyun
    shadowing a fresh /usr/local/bin/aliyun on macOS Apple Silicon, which is
    the typical reason an "upgrade succeeded" appears to revert in the next
    shell session).
    """
    paths = []
    for d in os.environ.get("PATH", "").split(os.pathsep):
        cand = os.path.join(d, "aliyun")
        if os.path.isfile(cand) and os.access(cand, os.X_OK) and cand not in paths:
            paths.append(cand)
    return paths


def _arch_install_cmd(target_dir):
    """Build the platform/arch-specific aliyun CLI install command.

    target_dir: where to extract the binary (e.g. /usr/local/bin or ~/bin).
    Returns (cmd_string, needs_sudo).
    """
    plat = sys.platform
    machine = os.uname().machine.lower() if hasattr(os, "uname") else ""
    if plat == "darwin":
        arch = "arm64" if machine in ("arm64", "aarch64") else "amd64"
        url = f"https://aliyun-cli.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/aliyun-cli-macosx-latest-{arch}.tgz"
    else:
        arch = "arm64" if machine in ("arm64", "aarch64") else "amd64"
        url = f"https://aliyun-cli.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/aliyun-cli-linux-latest-{arch}.tgz"
    needs_sudo = target_dir.startswith("/usr/") or target_dir.startswith("/opt/")
    sudo = "sudo " if needs_sudo else ""
    cmd = (f"mkdir -p {target_dir} && "
           f"curl --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 120 -fsSL {url} | {sudo}tar xz -C {target_dir}/")
    return cmd, needs_sudo


def _has_brew_aliyun():
    """Detect whether Homebrew manages an `aliyun` formula on this host."""
    if sys.platform != "darwin":
        return False
    code, out, _ = run_cmd(["brew", "list", "--formula"])
    if code != 0:
        return False
    return any(line.strip() in ("aliyun-cli", "aliyun") for line in out.splitlines())


def _print_install_guidance(action_label, current_ver=""):
    """Print install/upgrade guidance with PATH-conflict awareness.

    action_label: 'install' or 'upgrade', used in the prompt to the user.
    """
    paths = _detect_aliyun_paths()
    brew_managed = _has_brew_aliyun()

    # Surface multi-binary conflict explicitly — this is the #1 reason
    # "upgrade looked fine but next session reverts to the old version".
    if len(paths) > 1:
        print(f"   ⚠️  Multiple aliyun binaries detected on PATH (the earlier one wins):")
        for p in paths:
            print(f"        - {p}")
        print(f"   → Writing a new version to /usr/local/bin alone may be shadowed by an older binary in a PATH directory listed earlier (typical case: on macOS Apple Silicon, /opt/homebrew/bin precedes /usr/local/bin).")

    if brew_managed:
        print(f"   → Homebrew is managing aliyun-cli; prefer `brew {action_label}` to avoid PATH-precedence shadowing:")
        print(f"     brew upgrade aliyun-cli   # or: brew install aliyun-cli")
        print(f"   → AGENT: ASK the user 'The current aliyun CLI {current_ver} is managed by Homebrew. Do you agree to run `brew upgrade aliyun-cli`?' After consent, run the command and re-run check.")
        return

    # Default: tarball install. Prefer /usr/local/bin (with sudo); fall back to ~/bin.
    sys_cmd, _ = _arch_install_cmd("/usr/local/bin")
    user_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/bin")
    user_cmd, _ = _arch_install_cmd(user_dir)

    print(f"   → AGENT: DO NOT stop. ASK the user: 'Do you agree to {action_label} aliyun CLI under /usr/local/bin (sudo required)? Without sudo, install under ~/bin instead (PATH must be appended).' After consent, run the corresponding command below, then re-run check.")
    print(f"   → Recommended {action_label} command (system dir, requires sudo):")
    print(f"     {sys_cmd}")
    print(f"   → Sudo-free fallback (user dir, no privilege escalation):")
    print(f"     {user_cmd}")
    print(f"     # Also append ~/bin to PATH; otherwise the next shell session reverts to the old version:")
    print(f"     echo 'export PATH=\"$HOME/bin:$PATH\"' >> ~/.zshrc   # bash users edit ~/.bashrc")
    print(f"     hash -r   # or under zsh: rehash; makes the current session pick up the new version immediately")
    print(f"   → After install/upgrade, you MUST run `which -a aliyun` and `aliyun version` to double-check the effective path and version, then re-run check.")


def cmd_check(_args):
    """Environment check: aliyun CLI version, appmanager-cli version, credentials."""
    print("=== Environment Check ===")
    errors = 0

    # 1. Check aliyun CLI
    code, stdout, _ = run_cmd(["aliyun", "version"])
    cli_ver = ""
    if code == 0 and stdout:
        m = re.search(r'(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)', stdout)
        if m:
            cli_ver = m.group(1)

    aliyun_paths = _detect_aliyun_paths()
    active_path = aliyun_paths[0] if aliyun_paths else ""

    if not cli_ver:
        print("❌ aliyun CLI: NOT INSTALLED")
        # NOTE: We DO NOT execute install commands automatically — installing software
        # to system directories (/usr/local/bin) requires elevated privileges and should
        # only run after explicit user consent. We print the suggested command so the
        # user/Agent can review and run it manually.
        _print_install_guidance("install")
        errors += 1
    elif version_gte(cli_ver, "3.3.19"):
        print(f"✅ aliyun CLI: {cli_ver} (≥3.3.19) [active: {active_path or 'unknown'}]")
        # Even when version is OK, warn on multi-binary PATH conflicts so users
        # can avoid future "upgrade reverts in next session" surprises.
        if len(aliyun_paths) > 1:
            print(f"   ⚠️  Multiple aliyun binaries on PATH (the earlier one wins); watch out for path conflicts on future upgrades:")
            for p in aliyun_paths:
                print(f"        - {p}")
    else:
        print(f"❌ aliyun CLI: {cli_ver} (requires ≥3.3.19) [active: {active_path or 'unknown'}]")
        _print_install_guidance("upgrade", current_ver=cli_ver)
        errors += 1

    # 2. Check appmanager-cli
    venv_dir = os.path.expanduser("~/.aliyun/appmanager-venv")
    required_app = "1.1.1"
    if os.path.isdir(venv_dir):
        venv_python = os.path.join(venv_dir, "bin", "python")
        code, stdout, _ = run_cmd([venv_python, "-c",
            "from importlib.metadata import version; print(version('appmanager-cli'))"])
        app_ver = stdout.strip() if code == 0 else ""
        if not app_ver:
            print(f"❌ appmanager-cli: BROKEN venv (fix: rm -rf {venv_dir})")
            print(f"   → AGENT: DO NOT stop. ASK the user 'The appmanager-cli virtualenv appears broken. Do you agree to remove {venv_dir} and let aliyun CLI rebuild it automatically?' On 'yes' run: rm -rf {venv_dir}")
            errors += 1
        elif version_gte(app_ver, required_app):
            print(f"✅ appmanager-cli: {app_ver} (≥{required_app})")
        else:
            print(f"❌ appmanager-cli: {app_ver} (requires ≥{required_app}, fix: rm -rf {venv_dir})")
            print(f"   → AGENT: DO NOT stop. ASK the user 'The current appmanager-cli {app_ver} is below the required ≥{required_app}. Do you agree to remove {venv_dir} so aliyun CLI can rebuild it to the latest version?' On 'yes' run: rm -rf {venv_dir}")
            errors += 1
    else:
        print("⚠️  appmanager-cli: not installed yet (will auto-install on first aliyun appmanager run)")

    # 3. Check credentials
    config_file = os.path.expanduser("~/.aliyun/config.json")
    if os.path.isfile(config_file):
        try:
            with open(config_file) as f:
                d = json.load(f)
            current = d.get("current", "")
            profiles = d.get("profiles", [])
            p = next((x for x in profiles if x.get("name") == current), {})
            ak = p.get("access_key_id", "")
            region = p.get("region_id", "")
            if ak:
                # Mask AK: show only the prefix tag (4 chars) + last 4 chars, redact middle.
                # This avoids leaking enough characters for reconnaissance while still
                # letting the user identify which key is in use.
                if len(ak) >= 12:
                    masked = f"{ak[:4]}***{ak[-4:]}"
                else:
                    masked = "***"
                print(f"✅ credentials: profile={current} region={region} ak={masked}")
            else:
                print("❌ credentials: config.json exists but no valid AK found")
                print("   → SA-2.12: configure credentials via the default credential chain (do NOT paste AK/SK to the agent).")
                print("     A) ECS RAM Role: aliyun configure --mode EcsRamRole --ram-role-name <role>")
                print("     B) Env vars (in your shell profile): export ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID=... ; export ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET=...")
                print("     C) Interactive: aliyun configure --mode AK   (enter values at the terminal prompt)")
                errors += 1
        except Exception:
            print("❌ credentials: failed to parse config.json")
            errors += 1
    else:
        print("❌ credentials: ~/.aliyun/config.json not found")
        print("   → SA-2.12: configure credentials via the default credential chain (do NOT paste AK/SK to the agent).")
        print("     A) ECS RAM Role: aliyun configure --mode EcsRamRole --ram-role-name <role>")
        print("     B) Env vars (in your shell profile): export ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID=... ; export ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET=...")
        print("     C) Interactive: aliyun configure --mode AK   (enter values at the terminal prompt)")
        errors += 1

    print("=== Environment Check Done ===")
    if errors > 0:
        print(f"\n⚠️  {errors} issue(s) found. Please fix before deploying.")
        sys.exit(1)
    else:
        print("\n✅ All checks passed. Ready to deploy.")
        sys.exit(0)


# ============================================================
# Subcommand: price
# ============================================================

def cmd_price(args):
    """Query deployment price estimation and output summary."""
    config_path = args.config
    if not os.path.isfile(config_path):
        print(f"❌ Config file not found: {config_path}")
        print("Please run 'aliyun appmanager init' first to generate the config file.")
        sys.exit(1)

    cmd = ["aliyun", "appmanager", "price",
           "--config", os.path.abspath(config_path),
           "--target", args.target.upper(),
           "--output", "json"]
    if args.region:
        cmd += ["--region", args.region]

    # Don't pass expired STS tokens
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "ALIBABA_CLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN"}

    print("🔍 Querying price, please wait...\n")
    try:
        code, stdout, stderr = run_cmd(cmd, env_override=env, timeout=60)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Price query failed: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Parse NDJSON for last result/error
    last_event = None
    for line in stdout.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            ev = json.loads(line)
            if ev.get("type") in ("result", "error"):
                last_event = ev
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue

    if code != 0 or not last_event or last_event.get("type") == "error":
        msg = (last_event or {}).get("error") or stderr or "unknown error"
        print(f"❌ Price query failed: {msg}")
        print("\nPossible causes:")
        print("  1. Alibaba Cloud credentials are invalid or expired")
        print("  2. config.yaml parameters are incomplete")
        print("  3. Network connectivity issue")
        print("\nSuggestion: verify credentials and retry")
        sys.exit(1)

    result = last_event
    # Build summary
    lines = [
        "=" * 50, "📊 Deployment Cost Estimate", "=" * 50,
        f"Region        : {result['region_id']}",
        f"Deploy Target : {result['deploy_target']}",
        f"Service ID    : {result['service_id']}",
        f"Template Name : {result['template_name']}",
    ]
    # Display real instance type spec (CPU/Memory) to avoid Agent guessing from the name
    instance_spec = result.get('instance_type_spec') or {}
    instance_type = result.get('instance_type') or ''
    if instance_type:
        if instance_spec and instance_spec.get('cpu_core_count'):
            cpu = instance_spec['cpu_core_count']
            mem = instance_spec.get('memory_size', 0)
            mem_str = f"{int(mem)}GiB" if float(mem) == int(mem) else f"{mem}GiB"
            lines.append(f"Instance Type : {instance_type}  ({cpu}vCPU {mem_str})")
        else:
            lines.append(f"Instance Type : {instance_type}")
    lines.append("-" * 50)
    total_hourly = 0.0
    for res in result["resources"]:
        lines.append(f"\n📦 Resource: {res['name']}")
        lines.append(f"   Type        : {res['type']}")
        lines.append(f"   Charge Type : {res['charge_type']} ({res['price_unit']})")
        lines.append(f"   Quantity    : {res['quantity']}")
        lines.append("")
        for item in res["items"]:
            lines.append(f"   ├─ {item['resource']:<12} ¥{item['trade_amount']:>10.5f}/h  ({item['attributes']})")
        lines.append(f"   └─ Subtotal   : ¥{res['total_trade']:.5f}/h")
        if res["price_unit"] == "/Hour":
            total_hourly += res["total_trade"]
        for assoc in res.get("association", []):
            lines.append(
                f"   ⚡ Associated charge: {assoc['charge_type']} ¥{assoc['trade_amount']}{assoc['currency']}{assoc['price_unit']} "
                f"(billed by actual usage; not included in the total)")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("=" * 50)
    if total_hourly > 0:
        monthly = total_hourly * 24 * 30
        lines.append(f"💰 Total: ¥{total_hourly:.5f}/hour")
        lines.append(f"   Monthly estimate: ¥{monthly:.2f}/month (assuming 30 days × 24 hours)")
    else:
        lines.append("💰 Total: free (or no pay-as-you-go resources)")
    lines.append("=" * 50)
    lines.append("\n⚠️  These are estimated prices; the final amount is subject to your bill.")
    lines.append("⚠️  Associated charges (e.g. traffic-based network bandwidth) are billed by actual usage.")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("📦 OSS extra charges (not covered by `appmanager price`; please relay to the user):")
    lines.append("    - OSS Standard storage: ~¥0.12/GB/month (project code packages are usually KB~MB; small but non-zero)")
    lines.append("    - OSS public-network egress: ~¥0.50/GB (free when ECS and OSS are in the same region via intranet; cross-region traffic is billed)")
    lines.append("    - OSS Put/Get requests: billed per 10K requests; negligible")
    lines.append(f"\n📋 RequestID: {result.get('request_id', 'N/A')}\n")
    print("\n".join(lines))

    # =====================================================================
    # Risk warnings (key confirmation items beyond pricing)
    # =====================================================================
    risks = _collect_deploy_risks(config_path, args.region)
    has_warning = bool(risks["existing_ecs"]) or risks["group_state"] in ("HAS_ECS", "NO_ECS")
    if has_warning:
        print("\n" + "=" * 50)
        print("⚠️  Deployment Risk Warnings (please confirm each item with the user)")
        print("=" * 50)

    # R1: Existing-ECS deployment impact
    if risks["existing_ecs"]:
        print(f"🖥️  [Existing-ECS deployment risk] Will deploy to the user-specified existing ECS instance: {risks['existing_ecs']}")
        print("    - The deploy process will run stop → upload new code → start scripts on this instance")
        print("    - If other services are also running on this ECS, they may be killed by the stop script or have their ports taken by the new process")
        print("    - Files with the same name under deploy directories such as /root/ may be overwritten")
        print("    → AGENT: ASK the user 'Deploy is about to target existing ECS instance {iid}. Other applications running on it may be affected (stopped/port conflict/file overwrite). Do you confirm to proceed?'".format(iid=risks["existing_ecs"]))

    # R2: Existing app-group overwrite
    if risks["group_state"] == "HAS_ECS":
        if risks["existing_ecs"]:
            print("")
        print(f"📁 [App-group overwrite risk] Group '{risks['group_name']}' of app '{risks['app_name']}' already exists and is bound to ECS ({risks['ecs_ids']}).")
        print("    - Default behavior: use --overwrite to deploy onto the existing ECS in the existing group (replace app code, restart processes)")
        print("    - Alternative: create a brand-new group (preserve the existing deployment; spin up another ECS in the new group to run the new version)")
        print("    → AGENT: ASK the user 'App group {grp} already has a deployment. Please choose: A) overwrite the existing group (replace code, restart); B) create a brand-new group (keep the existing deployment intact).'".format(grp=risks["group_name"]))
        print("    → If the user chooses A: run deploy_toolkit.py deploy directly (default overwrite)")
        print("    → If the user chooses B: run deploy_toolkit.py deploy --force-new-group; the script will allocate a new group name and write it back to config.yaml")
    elif risks["group_state"] == "NO_ECS":
        if risks["existing_ecs"]:
            print("")
        print(f"📁 [Failed-leftover group] Group '{risks['group_name']}' exists but has no active ECS (likely a leftover from a previous failed deploy); a suffix will be appended to allocate a new group automatically.")

    if has_warning:
        print("=" * 50)

    print("=== AGENT_CONFIRM_REQUIRED ===")
    print("The Agent MUST ask the user to confirm each of the following based on the information above:")
    print("  1) Price confirmation (including the OSS extra-charge reminder)")
    if risks["existing_ecs"]:
        print(f"  2) Whether to agree to deploy to existing ECS instance {risks['existing_ecs']} (other apps on it may be affected)")
    if risks["group_state"] == "HAS_ECS":
        print(f"  3) App group '{risks['group_name']}' already has a deployment: overwrite (A) or create a brand-new group (B)")
    print("Only invoke deploy_toolkit.py deploy after every item has been confirmed.")
    sys.exit(0)


def _collect_deploy_risks(config_path, region_arg=""):
    """Collect deployment risk signals from config.yaml + appmanager status.

    Returns dict:
      - existing_ecs: instance id string if user-supplied existing ECS (else "")
      - group_state: NOT_EXISTS / HAS_ECS / NO_ECS / UNKNOWN
      - app_name, group_name, app_type, ecs_ids
    """
    risks = {"existing_ecs": "", "group_state": "UNKNOWN",
             "app_name": "", "group_name": "", "app_type": "", "ecs_ids": []}
    try:
        import yaml
        with open(config_path) as f:
            cfg = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
    except Exception:
        return risks

    meta = cfg.get("metadata", {}) or {}
    risks["app_type"] = meta.get("type", "")
    risks["app_name"] = meta.get("name", "")
    risks["group_name"] = meta.get("groupName", "")

    # existing-ECS detection: instanceId field is set when user chose existing ECS
    common = (cfg.get("common", {}) or {}).get("deployment", {}) or {}
    iid = common.get("instanceId") or common.get("instance_id") or ""
    if iid:
        risks["existing_ecs"] = iid

    # status check: only meaningful if all key fields present
    if risks["app_type"] and risks["app_name"] and risks["group_name"]:
        cmd = ["aliyun", "appmanager", risks["app_type"], "status",
               "--name", risks["app_name"],
               "--group_name", risks["group_name"],
               "--output", "json"]
        env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != "ALIBABA_CLOUD_SECURITY_TOKEN"}
        code, stdout, _ = run_cmd(cmd, env_override=env, timeout=30)
        if "EntityNotExists" in stdout:
            risks["group_state"] = "NOT_EXISTS"
        else:
            try:
                d = json.loads(stdout)
                d = d.get("data", d)
                ids = d.get("ecs_instance_ids", []) or []
                risks["ecs_ids"] = ids
                risks["group_state"] = "HAS_ECS" if ids else "NO_ECS"
            except Exception:
                risks["group_state"] = "UNKNOWN"
    return risks

def cmd_deploy(args):
    """Pre-deploy group check + execute deployment.

    Idempotency note (RECOMMEND §1.4.2):
        `aliyun appmanager deploy` does not currently expose a ClientToken parameter,
        so true server-side idempotency is not available at the CLI layer. This
        function instead implements a check-then-act pattern:
          1. Status query (`aliyun appmanager <type> status`) determines whether a
             group already exists with active ECS — in that case `--overwrite`
             updates the existing instance instead of creating a new one.
          2. If a previous failed deploy left a group with NO active ECS
             (NO_ECS state), a suffixed group name is allocated to avoid
             accidental resource duplication on retry.
        Agents that retry on transient errors (timeout, network) should call this
        subcommand again — the status check makes the operation safe to repeat.
    """
    args = fill_params(args)
    app_type, app_name, group_name, region = args.type, args.name, args.group, args.region

    print("=== Pre-deploy Group Check + Deploy ===")
    print(f"Type: {app_type} | Name: {app_name} | Group: {group_name} | Region: {region}\n")

    # Step 1: Check group status
    print("--- Step 1: Checking group status ---")
    code, stdout, _ = run_cmd(["aliyun", "appmanager", app_type, "status",
                               "--name", app_name, "--group_name", group_name, "--output", "json"])
    print(stdout)

    # Determine group state
    group_state = "UNKNOWN"
    if "EntityNotExists" in stdout:
        group_state = "NOT_EXISTS"
    else:
        try:
            data = json.loads(stdout)
            d = data.get("data", data)
            ids = d.get("ecs_instance_ids", [])
            group_state = "HAS_ECS" if ids and len(ids) > 0 else "NO_ECS"
        except Exception:
            if "EntityNotExists" in stdout:
                group_state = "NOT_EXISTS"

    print(f"Group state: {group_state}\n")

    # Step 2: Handle group state
    final_group = group_name
    force_new = getattr(args, "force_new_group", False)
    if force_new and group_state in ("HAS_ECS", "NO_ECS"):
        # User explicitly chose option B (brand-new group) at the price-and-risk gate.
        print("ℹ️  --force-new-group specified — allocating a brand-new group (preserving existing deployment).")
        group_state = "NO_ECS"  # Reuse the suffix-allocation branch below

    if group_state == "NOT_EXISTS":
        print("✅ Group does not exist — will be created during deploy.")
    elif group_state == "HAS_ECS":
        print("✅ Group exists with active ECS — deploy will update existing instance.")
    elif group_state == "NO_ECS":
        if force_new:
            print("⚠️  Force-new-group mode: appending suffix to create a brand-new group...\n")
        else:
            print("⚠️  Group exists but has NO active ECS instance (likely a failed previous deployment).")
            print("   Auto-resolving: appending suffix to create a new group...\n")
        for suffix in range(2, 11):
            new_group = f"{group_name}-{suffix}"
            c, out, _ = run_cmd(["aliyun", "appmanager", app_type, "status",
                                 "--name", app_name, "--group_name", new_group, "--output", "json"])
            if "EntityNotExists" in out:
                final_group = new_group
                break
        else:
            print("❌ Too many conflicting groups (tried up to suffix -10). Please clean up manually.")
            sys.exit(1)
        print(f"   New group name: {final_group}")
        # Update config.yaml
        config_file = ".appmanager/config.yaml"
        if os.path.isfile(config_file):
            try:
                import yaml
                with open(config_file) as f:
                    config = yaml.safe_load(f)
                config.setdefault("metadata", {})["groupName"] = final_group
                with open(config_file, "w") as f:
                    yaml.dump(config, f, default_flow_style=False, allow_unicode=True)
                print(f"   Updated .appmanager/config.yaml → groupName: {final_group}")
            except Exception:
                print("   ⚠️  Failed to update config.yaml — Agent must update groupName manually.")
        print()
    else:
        print("⚠️  Could not determine group state (status check may have failed).")
        print("   Proceeding with deploy anyway...")

    # Step 3: Execute deploy
    print("--- Step 3: Deploying ---")
    # appmanager-cli deploy does NOT auto-resolve region from config.yaml or
    # profile; without an explicit --region (and matching env var) it fails
    # with `InvalidParameter: DeployRegionId is invalid`. Pass both for
    # defense-in-depth so the call works across appmanager-cli minor versions.
    deploy_cmd = ["aliyun", "appmanager", app_type, "deploy", "--overwrite", "--output", "json"]
    if region:
        deploy_cmd += ["--region", region]
    print(f"Command: {' '.join(deploy_cmd)}\n")
    deploy_env = os.environ.copy()
    if region:
        deploy_env.setdefault("ALIBABA_CLOUD_REGION_ID", region)
    deploy_exit, deploy_output, _ = run_cmd(deploy_cmd, stream=True, env_override=deploy_env)
    print()

    # Step 4: Post-deploy summary
    if deploy_exit == 0:
        print("--- Deploy command completed (exit 0) ---")
        if final_group != group_name:
            print(f"""
===========================================
⚠️  Group-conflict auto-resolution notice:
   The original group '{group_name}' exists but has no associated ECS instance
   (likely a leftover from a previous failed deploy).
   A new group '{final_group}' has been created automatically and the deploy completed there.

   Suggestions for the old group:
   - Delete it if no longer needed:
     aliyun appmanager {app_type} delete --name {app_name} --group_name {group_name}
   - To reuse an existing ECS, set
     common.deployment.instanceId in config.yaml to import that ECS into the old group
===========================================""")
        print(f"\n✅ Deploy submitted. Use 'deploy_toolkit.py verify' to check if app is actually running.")
        sys.exit(0)
    else:
        print(f"--- Deploy command FAILED (exit {deploy_exit}) ---")
        # Extract error status
        deploy_status = ""
        script_error = ""
        for line in deploy_output.splitlines():
            line = line.strip()
            try:
                d = json.loads(line)
                if d.get("type") == "error":
                    deploy_status = d.get("error", "")
                for key in ("data", "execution_log"):
                    sub = d.get(key, {})
                    if isinstance(sub, dict):
                        outputs = sub.get("Outputs", {})
                        if isinstance(outputs, dict):
                            dco = outputs.get("deployCommandOutput")
                            if dco and dco not in ("null", None, [None]):
                                script_error = dco if isinstance(dco, str) else str(dco)
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
                pass

        is_cancelled = "ReleaseCancelled" in deploy_status
        is_failed = "ReleaseFailed" in deploy_status
        is_balance = "NotEnoughBalance" in deploy_output or "NotEnoughBalance" in deploy_status

        if is_balance:
            print("\n❌ Deploy failed: insufficient account balance")
            print("   ⚠️  Error code: InvalidAccountStatus.NotEnoughBalance")
            print("   ⚠️  Creating a pay-as-you-go ECS instance requires an account balance ≥ ¥100.")
            print("   ⚠️  Please top up via the Alibaba Cloud console and retry: https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/finance/fund-management")
            print("   Tip: this restriction does not apply when deploying to an existing ECS instance.")
        elif is_cancelled or is_failed:
            status_label = "ReleaseCancelled" if is_cancelled else "ReleaseFailed"
            print(f"\n❌ Deploy failed (status: {status_label})")
            print('   ⚠️  Meaning: the start script failed or timed out on ECS, and the platform forcibly terminated the release.')
            print('   ⚠️  This is NOT "a deploy is still in progress"; it is NOT "wait a moment and retry".')
            print("   ⚠️  The only correct next step: immediately run deploy_toolkit.py verify to inspect the actual error log.")
        elif deploy_status:
            print(f"\n❌ Deploy error: {deploy_status}")

        if script_error:
            print(f"\n=== Script execution error (deployCommandOutput) ===\n{script_error}")
            print("===========================================\n")
            print("👆 The above is the actual error from the start script on ECS. Fix the start script in .appmanager/config.yaml accordingly, then redeploy.")
        else:
            print("\n❌ Failed to extract a script log from the deploy output.")
            print("   Please run deploy_toolkit.py verify to query the actual deploy log on ECS and locate the failure cause.")
        sys.exit(1)
